source.name: Project Hoomans Social Conversation Director Content

translations.EN: I've got work to do. I'll get on it.
translations.TL: May trabaho akong gagawin. Aasikasuhin ko na.

translations.EN: Understood. Starting on the task now.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Sisimulan ko na ang gawain.

translations.EN: Task received. I'll take care of this.
translations.TL: Natanggap ang utos. Ako na ang bahala rito.

translations.EN: Right. Getting down to business.
translations.TL: Sige. Sisimulan na ang trabaho.

translations.EN: I'm on it. Shouldn't take too long.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso ko na. Hindi magtatagal ito.

translations.EN: Understood. I will handle this duty.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Hahawakan ko ang tungkuling ito.

translations.EN: Got my assignment. Moving out to work.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang atas ko. Kikilos na para magtrabaho.

translations.EN: Fair enough. Time to get my hands dirty.
translations.TL: Makatwiran. Oras na para magbanat ng buto.

translations.EN: I'll see that this gets done properly.
translations.TL: Titiyakin kong matatapos ito nang maayos.

translations.EN: Acknowledged. Working on the assigned job.
translations.TL: Kinikilala ko. Gagawin na ang iniatas na trabaho.

translations.EN: Happy to help with this! I'll get right on it.
translations.TL: Masayang tumulong dito! Aasikasuhin ko agad.

translations.EN: Leave it to me, friend. I'll make sure it's done right.
translations.TL: Ipaubaya mo sa akin, kaibigan. Titiyakin kong maayos ito.

translations.EN: Glad to contribute to our camp. Heading over now.
translations.TL: Masayang makapag-ambag sa kampo natin. Pupunta na ako roon.

translations.EN: You can count on me. I'll take good care of it.
translations.TL: Makaaasa ka sa akin. Aalagaan ko itong mabuti.

translations.EN: On it! Always happy to do my part for the team.
translations.TL: Aasikasuhin na! Laging masayang gawin ang bahagi ko para sa grupo.

translations.EN: Consider it handled, partner. Be back soon.
translations.TL: Ituring mong ayos na, kasama. Babalik ako agad.

translations.EN: Happy to take this off your hands. Working on it now.
translations.TL: Masayang alisin ang bigat na 'to sa 'yo. Gagawin ko na ngayon.

translations.EN: I'll pour my best effort into this for all of us.
translations.TL: Ibubuhos ko ang buong makakaya ko para sa ating lahat.

translations.EN: Got the task! Thanks for trusting me with it.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko ang atas! Salamat sa pagtitiwala sa akin.

translations.EN: Right away, friend! Let's keep our home running.
translations.TL: Agad-agad, kaibigan! Panatilihin nating maayos ang tirahan natin.

translations.EN: On it.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso na.

translations.EN: Working.
translations.TL: Nagtatrabaho na.

translations.EN: Understood.
translations.TL: Naintindihan.

translations.EN: Doing it.
translations.TL: Ginagawa na.

translations.EN: Got it.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko.

translations.EN: Assigned.
translations.TL: Iniatas.

translations.EN: Starting.
translations.TL: Nagsisimula na.

translations.EN: Handling it.
translations.TL: Hinahawakan na.

translations.EN: Right.
translations.TL: Sige.

translations.EN: Moving.
translations.TL: Kumikilos na.

translations.EN: I'll do the work. Watch my back while I do.
translations.TL: Gagawin ko ang trabaho. Bantayan mo ang likod ko habang ginagawa.

translations.EN: I'll handle it, but keep an eye on our surroundings.
translations.TL: Ako na ang bahala, pero magmasid ka sa paligid.

translations.EN: Understood. Don't crowd me while I'm working.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Huwag mo akong dikitan habang nagtatrabaho.

translations.EN: I'll do my share. Make sure you do yours.
translations.TL: Gagawin ko ang bahagi ko. Tiyakin mong gagawin mo ang sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Getting on it. Stay alert for threats.
translations.TL: Sisimulan na. Manatiling alisto sa mga banta.

translations.EN: I'll get it done. Just make sure the perimeter is secure.
translations.TL: Matatapos ko ito. Tiyakin mo lang na ligtas ang paligid.

translations.EN: Task noted. I'll finish it without distraction.
translations.TL: Tala ang gawain. Tatapusin ko nang walang abala.

translations.EN: Fine. I'll see to the task.
translations.TL: Sige. Aasikasuhin ko ang gawain.

translations.EN: I'll handle this. Keep your weapon ready.
translations.TL: Hahawakan ko ito. Ihanda mo ang armas mo.

translations.EN: Understood. Don't let anything sneak up on me.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Huwag kang magpapapasok ng kahit ano sa likod ko.

translations.EN: That's done. One less thing to worry about.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Isang alalahanin ang nabawas.

translations.EN: Finished the task. All wrapped up.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang gawain. Ayos na ang lahat.

translations.EN: Job is complete. What's next?
translations.TL: Tapos na ang trabaho. Ano ang susunod?

translations.EN: That takes care of that assignment.
translations.TL: Naasikaso na ang tungkuling iyon.

translations.EN: All done here. Everything looks in order.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang lahat dito. Maayos ang kalagayan.

translations.EN: Task is completed to the best of my ability.
translations.TL: Natapos ang gawain sa abot ng aking makakaya.

translations.EN: Wrapped that up. Ready for the next priority.
translations.TL: Tapos na iyon. Handa na para sa susunod na prayoridad.

translations.EN: Done. That should hold up fine.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Maayos ang magiging tibay niyan.

translations.EN: The work is finished. Moving on.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang trabaho. Magpatuloy na.

translations.EN: Completed. Duty handled.
translations.TL: Kumpleto na. Naasikaso ang tungkulin.

translations.EN: All finished! Glad I could help get this done.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang lahat! Mabuti at nakatulong akong tapusin ito.

translations.EN: That's taken care of, friend. Turned out great!
translations.TL: Naasikaso na 'yon, kaibigan. Naging napakaganda ng resulta!

translations.EN: Proud to have this knocked out for the camp.
translations.TL: Ipinagmamalaki kong natapos ito para sa kampo.

translations.EN: Finished! We're making our home a little better every day.
translations.TL: Tapos na! Pinapaganda natin ang tirahan natin araw-araw.

translations.EN: Done and dusted! Let me know if you need another hand.
translations.TL: Tapos at malinis na! Sabihan mo lang ako kung kailangan mo pa ng tulong.

translations.EN: Completed with care. Hope it meets your expectations, partner.
translations.TL: Tinapos nang buong puso. Sana pumasa sa pamantayan mo, kasama.

translations.EN: That was tough, but we did it! All finished.
translations.TL: Mabigat 'yon, pero kinaya natin! Tapos na ang lahat.

translations.EN: One more step toward surviving comfortably. All done!
translations.TL: Isa na namang hakbang para maging maginhawa rito. Tapos na!

translations.EN: Done! Happy to do my part for our people.
translations.TL: Tapos na! Masayang gawin ang parte ko para sa kasamahan natin.

translations.EN: All set! Feels good to get something productive accomplished.
translations.TL: Handa na! Masarap sa pakiramdam na may natapos na kapaki-pakinabang.

translations.EN: Done.
translations.TL: Tapos na.

translations.EN: Finished.
translations.TL: Tapos.

translations.EN: Completed.
translations.TL: Kumpleto.

translations.EN: Handled.
translations.TL: Naasikaso na.

translations.EN: Sorted.
translations.TL: Ayos na.

translations.EN: All set.
translations.TL: Handa na.

translations.EN: Wrapped up.
translations.TL: Tapos na lahat.

translations.EN: Next?
translations.TL: Susunod?

translations.EN: Cleared.
translations.TL: Malinaw na.

translations.EN: Ready.
translations.TL: Handa na.

translations.EN: Task is done. I'm taking a breather.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang gawain. Magpapahinga muna ako.

translations.EN: Finished. Inspect it if you want to be sure.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Suriin mo kung nais mong makatiyak.

translations.EN: It's completed. Now keep your eyes open.
translations.TL: Tapos na ito. Ngayon buksan mo ang mga mata mo.

translations.EN: That job is handled. Back to guarding the perimeter.
translations.TL: Naasikaso na ang trabaho. Balik sa pagbabantay ng paligid.

translations.EN: Finished my duty. Nobody snuck up on us, right?
translations.TL: Tapos na ang tungkulin ko. Walang nakalapit sa atin, di ba?

translations.EN: Done. Let's make sure it wasn't for nothing.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Tiyakin nating hindi nasayang ang pagod.

translations.EN: Work is complete. Back on defensive watch.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang trabaho. Balik sa pagbabantay.

translations.EN: It's finished. Keep quiet and stay alert.
translations.TL: Tapos na. Manatiling tahimik at alisto.

translations.EN: Task completed. Don't waste the resources I secured.
translations.TL: Gawain natapos. Huwag mong sayangin ang naasikaso ko.

translations.EN: Done. What's the next threat we need to manage?
translations.TL: Tapos na. Ano ang susunod na banta na dapat harapin?

translations.EN: Looks clear now. That got rough for a minute.
translations.TL: Mukhang malinaw na. Naging delikado sandali.

translations.EN: Area is secure. Check yourselves for injuries.
translations.TL: Ligtas na ang lugar. Tingnan niyo kung may mga sugat kayo.

translations.EN: They're all down. Take a breath and reload.
translations.TL: Tumba na silang lahat. Huminga at magkarga ng bala.

translations.EN: Fight's over. Good work holding the line.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang laban. Magandang pagpigil sa linya.

translations.EN: Looks like the immediate threat is dealt with.
translations.TL: Mukhang naasikaso na ang agarang banta.

translations.EN: Clear. Everyone still in one piece?
translations.TL: Malinaw. Buo pa ba ang lahat?

translations.EN: Threat neutralized. Let's recover our stamina.
translations.TL: Nalipol ang banta. Bawiin natin ang lakas natin.

translations.EN: It's quiet again. Stay alert for stragglers.
translations.TL: Tahimik na ulit. Magbantay sa mga naiwan.

translations.EN: Combat is finished. Reload and bandage up.
translations.TL: Tapos na ang bakbakan. Magkarga at magbenda.

translations.EN: We held them off. Area appears clear.
translations.TL: Naitaboy natin sila. Mukhang malinis na ang lugar.

translations.EN: We made it through! Is everyone okay?
translations.TL: Nakalusot tayo! Ayos lang ba ang lahat?

translations.EN: Thank goodness you're alive. That was terrifying.
translations.TL: Salamat sa Diyos at buhay ka. Napakatindi noon.

translations.EN: Great fighting, partner! I'm so glad we survived that.
translations.TL: Napakagaling mong lumaban, kasama! Masayang-masaya ako't nakaligtas tayo.

translations.EN: Come here, let me check you over for bites or scratches.
translations.TL: Halika rito, titingnan ko kung may kagat o gasgas ka.

translations.EN: We did it together. Nobody got left behind.
translations.TL: Nagawa natin nang magkasama. Walang naiwan sa atin.

translations.EN: Take a breath, friend. We held the line.
translations.TL: Huminga ka muna, kaibigan. Naipagtanggol natin ang pwesto.

translations.EN: I was worried for a second there, but you fought bravely.
translations.TL: Nag-alala ako nang sandali, pero buong tapang kang lumaban.

translations.EN: Proud to stand beside you in that fight. We're safe now.
translations.TL: Ipinagmamalaki kong tumabi sa 'yo sa laban. Ligtas na tayo ngayon.

translations.EN: Rest for a minute. You earned it after that mess.
translations.TL: Magpahinga ka muna. Karapat-dapat ka roon pagkatapos ng gulo.

translations.EN: All clear! Hugely relieved we're both standing.
translations.TL: Malinis na! Napakalaking ginhawa na nakatayo pa tayong pareho.

translations.EN: Clear.
translations.TL: Malinaw.

translations.EN: All down.
translations.TL: Tumba lahat.

translations.EN: Reload.
translations.TL: Magkarga.

translations.EN: Check wounds.
translations.TL: Tingnan ang sugat.

translations.EN: Secure.
translations.TL: Ligtas.

translations.EN: Done.
translations.TL: Tapos.

translations.EN: Quiet now.
translations.TL: Tahimik na.

translations.EN: Hold positions.
translations.TL: Manatili sa pwesto.

translations.EN: Breathe.
translations.TL: Huminga.

translations.EN: Threat gone.
translations.TL: Wala nang banta.

translations.EN: Don't relax yet. Scan for stragglers.
translations.TL: Huwag munang magpakampante. Maghanap ng mga naiwan.

translations.EN: Down, but keep your weapon ready. More could be coming.
translations.TL: Tumba na, pero ihanda ang armas. Baka may paparating pa.

translations.EN: Check your perimeter before you start celebrating.
translations.TL: Suriin ang paligid bago magdiwang.

translations.EN: Check every corpse. Make sure they stay down.
translations.TL: Tingnan ang bawat bangkay. Tiyaking hindi na gagalaw.

translations.EN: Gunfire brings more of them. We need to be ready to move.
translations.TL: Nakahahatak ng iba ang putok. Maging handa tayong umalis.

translations.EN: Wipe your blade and reload immediately.
translations.TL: Punasan ang talim at magkarga agad ng bala.

translations.EN: Are you bitten? Answer me right now.
translations.TL: Kinagat ka ba? Sagutin mo ako ngayon din.

translations.EN: Threat is dead, but noise travels fast out here.
translations.TL: Patay ang banta, pero mabilis kumalat ang ingay dito.

translations.EN: Keep low. Don't silhouette yourself in the doorway.
translations.TL: Yumuko ka. Huwag mong i-expose ang sarili mo sa pinto.

translations.EN: Clear for now. Expect a second wave.
translations.TL: Malinis sa ngayon. Maghanda sa pangalawang bugso.
